result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: the header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels, and bottom navigation are aligned and legible. I found two minor content issues: a duplicated restaurant card and redundant delivery-fee information. The clipped chip and carousel items at the right edge and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are intentional scroll affordances and were not counted.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, time, and delivery fee, which looks like duplicated data.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source and remove the duplicate, or replace it with a distinct restaurant.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice, once as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in only one place to reduce redundancy.
